description: Controversy about Abortion Rights for WomenOn the 49th Anniversary of Roe V. Wade, which established women’s federal right to secure an abortion and limited the states’ ability to impose restrictions, we face the very real threat that this right to choose will be taken away. If women’s right to choose is removed by government, what will be the outcomes for women, and indeed, for the babies they are forced to carry and deliver?
